newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Esso Singapore cuts crude runs by 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Esso Singapore cuts crude runs by 10 pct.

text.p: Esso Singapore has cut crude runs at its 230,000 barrels-per-day (bpd) refinery by 10 percent, a source close to the company said on Tuesday.
The source said the refinery has cut runs due to recent refining losses.
The source did not provide details on when the refinery would resume normal runs.
Over the past week, refining margins have averaged at a loss of about 50-cents for every barrel refined at the basic stage.
Esso spokesman was unavailable for comment.
Other refiners in Singapore have yet to cut runs and are monitoring the situation closely.
The last rounds of refinery runs cut were in January when Singapore four refiners reduced output by between 8-20 percent.
"If the current margins squeeze continues, our refinery runs will be reduced,' a Shell spokewoman told Reuters on Monday.
